providerDefault: auto (which resolves to the project setting, normally `default`)
summary: Latency/price tier for processing the request.
combines: Supported on: `flex` on supported models for scale-tier customers; `fast`/`priority` for Fast mode (the response reports `priority` for both); `ultrafast` is access-controlled and currently only for `gpt-5.6-sol`
Direct cost lever: `flex` trades latency for a lower price; `priority`/`fast`/`ultrafast` pay more for lower latency.
The response body echoes the tier actually used, which may differ from what you asked for.
